Abecedario completo de letras con efecto globo, diseñado para crear nombres, palabras, carteles decorativos o proyectos personalizados con una estética inspirada en los clásicos globos metalizados. Las letras pueden imprimirse de varias formas, aunque recomiendo imprimirlas en posición vertical. De esta manera se conserva mejor el efecto volumétrico del diseño y se obtiene una superficie más limpia. Para garantizar una buena adhesión a la base, especialmente si se imprimen varias letras a la vez, es recomendable utilizar un brim amplio. Las letras mostradas en las fotografías se han impreso con filamento tricolor. Si utilizas este tipo de material, conviene prestar atención a la orientación de cada pieza, ya que el ángulo de impresión influirá directamente en la distribución de los colores y en el resultado final. Para obtener el mejor acabado posible, recomiendo utilizar una altura de capa reducida o, preferiblemente, altura de capa variable. El efecto globo se basa en superficies curvas y transiciones suaves que pierden definición cuando se utilizan capas demasiado gruesas. También es posible imprimir las letras en horizontal, pero en ese caso es especialmente importante utilizar una altura de capa muy fina o altura de capa variable para mantener el aspecto redondeado y evitar que se pierda parte del efecto característico del diseño. Se incluyen todas las letras del alfabeto para que cada usuario pueda crear sus propias combinaciones y personalizar completamente el resultado final.

description: Xenomorph (Alien) Ultra Detailed Display This one is by far one of my largest, and definitely the most detailed model that I've worked on to date.. This is an Ultra Detailed Xenomorph statue that stands 19 inches (48cm) tall in the largest form! This statue pulls inspiration from the unbelievably awesome Sideshow Collectibles Vinyl model, which if you are familiar with their models, are next level in detail.. but next to impossible to get! There are 2 size profiles being made available at the time of the model upload - 19" tall version as well as a 10" tall version. Please note that the 19" tall version is printed in pieces, and is maximized in size to fit the P/X series printer beds. The 10" tall version is printed a simplified one-piece print. I should know that I have printed 6 different size variants and will note that you can easily scale this between 10" and 19" tall models. **Please be aware that the print times are lengthy. I had 4 machines running test prints none stop. I promise though, it is worth it at the end. **Please also be aware that the model images you see are 100% real, with 0 use of AI, but they have been post-process colored using some Rub'n Buff waxes, along with some gloss clear coat layer application at the end. ASSEMBLY REQUIRED ** The 19" tall, multipiece print will require some glue. I have used both super glue, as well as hot glue. Hot glue was my preference. With all the parts printed, and supports cleaned up (TAKE YOUR TIME REMOVING THE SUPPORTS AS THE PARTS ARE HIGHLY DETAILED AND FRAGILE ) do a dry-fit of all the parts to ensure proper fitment. You may need to file down some pieces if they do not fit. All 4 of my models went together with no issues, but different printers/filaments may have some tolerance issues. Assembly is very straightfoward, with the exception of the tail. DO NOT mount the tail to the model until the Xenomoprh is placed onto the base display. The tail loops around the display and needs to be installed afterwards. Install the tail by turning is 90 degrees and carefully looping the tip around the back of the base and then gently rotating it up into the reciever cutout on he back of the xenomorph (Yes, it looks like a butt ). With the Dry fitting completed, if you are satisfied with the fitment you can take the piees apart and proceed to glue them together. As with the above test-fit process, you can assemble everything together, just leave the tail to the end. If you are planning to paint/apply color to the model I highly advise doing so with Xenomorph OFF of the base. For final assembly, apply some glue to the foot mounting peg as well as some glue to the toes of the left foot (there is no peg here) and firmly place the model on to the base. Proceed with snaking the tail into position, and then apply some glue onto the peg of the base of the tail. There is a small mounting support for the tail at the back of the base that also requires a small application of glue to help it from bouncing around with the model fully assembled. COLOR APPLICATION I used a very straightforward process for my coloring via application of some Rub'n Buff Antique Gold wax for the Xenomorph, and Brass color for the base. Wear gloves and apply the wax to a towel and gently go over the details. Avoid pressing really hard so that the void remain black/dark, this helps with final contrast of the model. As you can tell from these two photos the difference between the plain model and the colored one is pretty phenomenal and I HIGHLY recommend going through the effort!

Yes, I’m insane. Regular-sized figures and statues just aren’t my thing - So I modelled Batman from scratch and printed him…life sized. After printing, assembling and painting, I gave him a batcape, glass eyes, metal screwhead details and a glossy surface finish for his metal parts. I modelled him after the design in the arkham origins game because I think this is one of the sickest batsuit designs. Who agrees? If you happen to be equally crazy as I am and to actually download and print your own life-sized statue, here’s a few additional information: Print overview Batman himself consists of 40 parts which can be printed on every Bambu printer except for the A1 mini. His accessories on the belt as well as the batarang add another 11 parts making it a total of 51 parts. To identify each part, I created a general overview below. You can identify each part in the print profiles too - I named the print bed labels and the parts on it according to the overview. Because Bambu Studio won’t let me create more than 36 plates, I divided the parts into “Lower body”, “Torso & Head” and “Shoulders, arms & Accessories”. Each print profile has its own overview with the parts it contains. Assembling, Post-processing For assembling, there’s no connectors, screw holes or anything like that - Like a typical cosplay prop, the print itself just serves as the base and is then further refined, making the seams invisible and giving it a nice finish which will also hold everything together properly. I used a heated sculpting tool called Modifi3D to melt the seams together, which added a lot of strength already while also making the seams barely noticeable. And from this point on, it’s entirely up to you how far you want to take the surface finishing process. I coated everything in fiberglass which was a sh!tload of work but it really paid off in terms of both durability and appearance. And because there’s so many different ways, techniques and methods for the entire post-process, there’s no right or wrong when it comes to slicing and printing. I printed everything without infill and without top- or bottom surface (with a few exceptions), leaving the parts hollow, made of 6 wall loops. Sort of a vase mode. description: Anime Statue Series — Gabriel (Daemons of the Shadow Realm) Ultra-Real High-Capacity Storage Box 1. Concept & Design Following our tradition of bringing overwhelming anime menace into tangible reality, we turn our focus to one of the most visually striking and unsettling entities from Daemons of the Shadow Realm — Gabriel . This creation is not merely a static biological sculpture; it is a flawless fusion of high-end artistic presence and daily utility—introducing the Gabriel Ultra-Real High-Capacity Storage Box . Breaking away from boring, hard geometric boxes, this piece materializes Gabriel's chaotic nature: a jet-black form covered in an erratic array of staring eyes, paired with an iconic, razor-sharp open maw. It is built with an exaggerated organic tension, leaving a motionless yet unstable, living-alloy aura on your desk. Every contour is crafted to balance eerie nostalgia, dark expression, and genuine centerpiece impact. 2. Engineering & Printing Guide (Important: Multi-Color Recommendation) The storage box is meticulously engineered for maximum stability in large-scale FDM printing, ensuring long-term utility and print success. However, regarding the printing workflow and engineering structure, please read the following notes carefully: No "No-AMS" Parted Design This Time: I intentionally did not create a split-part, single-color version for this model. Through rigorous testing, I found that trying to manually insert and glue the countless eyeballs, tiny pupils, and interlocking sharp teeth post-print would be an absolute nightmare of tolerance frustration and pain for everyone involved. Time Efficiency Analysis: More importantly, my print benchmarks reveal that the difference between a solid single-color print and a full AMS multi-color print is only about 10 hours . Trading 10 hours of print time to completely bypass the agonizing hell of manual assembly is an incredible bargain. Therefore, I highly recommend that we don't overcomplicate things— let’s just go full multi-color directly together! Monolithic High-Strength Ballast Structure: This storage box utilizes a one-piece, permanently open static maw structure rather than an articulated lid. The rear spinal support and the base footprint are heavily reinforced for center-of-gravity compensation. Even when packed to the brim with heavy items like hardware or keys, the statue remains rock-solid and perfectly stable whenever you drop items into its jaw. 3. Display & Functionality As showcased in the product photos, Gabriel’s aggressive, wide-open jaw serves as an apex predator for desk clutter. It pairs beautifully as a functional storage solution for: Keys, USB drives, EDC rings, and loose hardware/screws. Tangled charging cables, or even hosting a small LED puck light inside (as seen in the pictures, the internal ambient glow pushes the biomechanical cosmic dread to the absolute limit). Whether stationed on your primary workstation or a hallway console, its aggressive silhouette featured across multiple angles delivers supreme stylized plausibility and unrivaled shelf presence. 4. Conclusion The Gabriel Hyper-Real Storage Box proves that catastrophic charm and immense visual impact don't have to sacrifice functional purpose. By choosing direct multi-color printing, it allows the madness of its gaze, grotesque aesthetics, and surreal realism to freeze flawlessly into a centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize failure risks around the deep overhangs and heavy back panel structures. Calibrate your flow rate properly and ensure your filament is completely dry—Bambu gray and black remain my absolute go-to filaments. Needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper make clearing supports from the tight crevices of the teeth incredibly efficient.

Este diseño de mariposa está pensado para ser una pieza versátil que puede servir como una delicada decoración o como un marcapáginas único. El modelo está diseñado específicamente para ser impreso directamente sobre tela de tul, lo que le otorga un fondo transparente y una textura muy especial. Instrucciones de Impresión (Técnica sobre tela) Para lograr que la mariposa quede adherida a la tela, es necesario seguir un proceso de impresión con pausa. Aquí están los pasos clave: Pausa programada: El archivo de impresión debe configurarse en el laminador (slicer) para que genere una pausa automática exactamente al terminar la primera capa . Colocación de la tela: Durante esta pausa, el cabezal se apartará. Es el momento de colocar la tela de tul estirada sobre la cama de impresión, justo por encima de la capa base que se acaba de imprimir. Fijación con imanes: Para evitar que el cabezal arrastre la tela o se formen arrugas, utiliza imanes en los bordes para fijar el tul firmemente a la base metálica de la impresora. Asegúrate de que los imanes queden fuera de la trayectoria del extrusor. Reanudación de la impresión: Una vez que la tela esté tensa y asegurada, reanuda la impresión. El plástico de las siguientes capas se fundirá a través de los agujeros de la malla del tul, encapsulando la tela y uniendo el diseño de forma permanente.

model_name: Mecha Pokemon Series — Beedrill Hyper-Real Statue
description: Mecha Pokémon Statue Series — Mecha Beedrill Hyper-Real Steel Sculpture 1. Concept & Design This sculpture reinterprets the iconic, lethal airborne assassin through the lens of heavy mechanical re-forging (Mecha Reforge). As the newest chapter of our "Mecha Pokémon Series," we turn our focus to the legendary high-speed apex predator of the Kanto region— Beedrill . This creation reimagines Beedrill’s aggressive biological silhouette into a heavy armored exoskeleton statue brimming with industrial rigidity. The design transforms its naturally lightweight abdomen and segments into layered, curved armor plates packed with dense mechanical panel lines, exuding immense physical mass and weaponized tension within a static warrior pose. Structurally, due to Beedrill's defining biological trait of having extremely small feet , achieving balance in large-scale monolithic FDM printing posed a significant challenge. To counter this, we engineered the right arm to drive its massive lance directly into the ground , establishing a rock-solid triangular base. However, this required a compromise: visually, it looks as though half of Beedrill's iconic twin stingers are missing. To fix this, we included an extra loose lance accessory just for you guys ! This bonus lance gives you complete display freedom—you can hang it on the raised left hand to create a gripping effect, holding it facing forward or backward. (Note: If you wish to completely lift it overhead, you will need to utilize an aftermarket action figure display stand for support). Of course, you can also get creative and print multiple extra lances to scatter around him, replicating an epic "infinite weapon arsenal" scene from certain anime series (lol). 2. Engineering & Printability The statue is highly optimized for large-scale FDM stability, prioritizing ballast physics and center-of-gravity compensation over part articulation: Support Removal & Structural Integrity: The primary printing hurdle with this model is that the supports beneath both arms are somewhat tricky to remove , requiring patience. On the flip side, the supports for the wings detach very easily. However, because the joint area connecting the wings to the main body is quite small , please handle them with care during cleanup so you don't accidentally snap the entire wing section off. The remaining parts should be smooth sailing for experienced makers. Minor Artifact Correction: If your print suffers from a slightly warped or misaligned pinky finger on the left hand , there's no need to scrap the print. Simply use a heat gun to gently soften the plastic, realign it, and secure it with a drop of glue. Geometric Shadow Readability: At 0.2 mm layer heights, the mechanical compound eyes, the layered armor on the torso, and the sweeping taper of the giant lances catch ambient light perfectly, throwing deep dual-density shadows that eliminate the absolute need for immediate painting. 3. Display & Customization With its sweeping, aggressive wingspan, Mecha Beedrill naturally commands a premium presence when staged inside industrial mecha bays, barren desert ruins, or post-apocalyptic military outposts. For advanced miniature painters and makers, the model offers limitless creative room for custom finishing: The expansive metal surfaces are perfectly suited for heavy weathering, grease-staining, and metallic edge dry-brushing. The deep recesses between the armor plates and the main lances are ideal for dropping high-contrast vivid hive-amber or neon toxic-green paints to simulate a lethal weapon system charging up. By printing several extra copies of the lance and staking them into a custom clay or foam terrain base, you can flawlessly recreate a "Gate of Babylon" styled boundless armory effect that dramatically elevates the visual impact. Whether positioned as a standalone desk centerpiece or integrated into a sci-fi diorama, its silhouette delivers superb stylized plausibility from every angle. 4. Conclusion The Hyper-Real Mecha Beedrill statue stands as a definitive showcase piece, proving that high collectible impact isn't born from moving parts, but from raw sculptural presence. It transforms a childhood memory into tangible awe—blending menace, mass, and sharp industrial geometry into an essential collector’s centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize stringing or failure risks around the delicate antennae and sweeping wing overhangs. Crucial Warning: If you plan on using a mini-torch or a heat gun to clear stringing and print residue from the wings, remember that the wings are extremely thin—please exercise extreme caution ! To prevent the thin geometry from softening and warping instantly upon heating, it is highly recommended to steady the wing with one hand while keeping the heat source moving rapidly. My absolute go-to filament for reading these industrial mechanical details remains the Bambu Lab gray series . When removing tight supports from beneath the arms, needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper will be your ultimate soulmates.

description: Goku SSJ2: Smart Multi-Part Design This figure represents Goku in his Super Saiyan 2 phase . Unlike traditional models that print as a single block, this design is fully segmented into independent parts, including the hair, head, torso, arms, pants, belt, and boots. This structural division simplifies both the printing process and the final finishing, eliminating the need to paint complex layers onto a single, solid surface. The model is specifically designed so you do not have to rely on expensive multi-material technologies like Bambu Lab's AMS . Because each element is separate, you can organize your build plates by color and print all pieces sharing the same tone together using the final colored filament directly (such as orange for the pants and torso, or yellow for the hair). This approach completely eliminates purge towers and the material waste generated by changing filaments on the same layer, resulting in significant savings of both time and plastic. Furthermore, it makes the model 100% compatible with any standard 3D printer on the market. Assembly is clean and precise thanks to a built-in system of connecting pins and custom-fit guide cavities. This male-female mechanism ensures that each part aligns geometrically and accurately, removing any risk of the limbs or head being rotated or crooked. You do not need screws or complex tools to permanently assemble the figure; all you need is cyanoacrylate glue (classic instant adhesive or Super Glue). The process is straightforward: first, perform a dry fit by assembling the parts to verify they fit properly and to clean away any remaining support material. Next, apply a single drop of glue to the connecting pin, press both parts firmly together for 10 to 15 seconds, and the structure will be completely secure.

model_name: Mecha Pokémon Statue Series — Mecha Lugia statue
description: Mecha Pokémon Statue Series — Mecha Lugia Hyper-Real Steel Sculpture 1. Concept & Design Following our tradition of heavy mechanical re-forging (Mecha Reforge) applied to iconic anime characters, we turn our focus to the legendary Guardian of the Seas from the Johto region— Lugia . This creation reimagines Lugia’s streamlined biological form through the lens of heavy industrial and military cyberpunk aesthetics. Moving away from low-detail smooth surfaces, the majesty of the diving sea god is materialized here as a dense, armored exoskeleton statue. Its roaring headline pose, the intricate neck cables alongside exposed hydraulic pistons, and the layered plating of the heavy chest armor exude an organic living-alloy tension and pure mechanical menace. Its iconic hands-like wings are re-engineered into heavy military-grade thruster wings, complete with articulated mechanical joints and individual aerodynamic slats. In this static stance, the signature dorsal plates running down to the tail are transformed into rigid external cooling fins, conveying a supreme sense of compressed energy beneath the armor. It commands an unparalleled centerpiece presence on any desk. 2. Engineering & Printability The statue is meticulously engineered for maximum stability in large-scale FDM printing, striking a perfect balance between hyper-dense mechanical detail and a reliable printing experience: Center-of-Gravity & Ballast Compensation: Due to Lugia's wide wingspan and heavy tail, the lower body volume has been strategically redistributed. The thick mechanical legs significantly increase the footprint surface area, working in tandem with the elongated segmented tail to form a rock-solid triangular base. Monolithic One-Shot Design: This model prints as a single static statue piece with no articulated joints or complex part segmentations, completely eliminating assembly tolerance alignment issues or loose fittings. Exceptional Geometric Readability: At 0.2 mm layer heights, the intricate armor panel lines, bolts, gears, and exposed wiring naturally catch the light, throwing deep dual-density shadows. Even straight off the build plate in solid gray filament, it delivers immense premium depth without immediate post-painting. 3. Display & Customization With its aggressive, expansive wingspan, Mecha Lugia naturally thrives in workbench displays, tactical mecha bays, or post-apocalyptic industrial backdrops. For advanced statue painters and makers, the model offers limitless creative room for custom finishing: It perfectly welcomes heavy weathering, dry-brush metallic chipping, or oil-slick griming. Adding a bright cyan or neon purple inner bloom paint inside the neck conduits, eye sockets, or chest core lines simulates an imminent "Aeroblast" energy charge. Whether positioned as your primary workstation centerpiece or a photography backdrop, its silhouette delivers supreme stylized plausibility and unrivaled shelf presence. 4. Conclusion The Hyper-Real Mecha Lugia statue stands as a definitive showcase piece for mecha enthusiasts and print collectors who adore stylized plausibility and catastrophic charm. It transforms a childhood legend into tangible awe—blending weight, sharp armor geometry, and frozen motion into one essential collector’s centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize stringing or failure risks around the heavy wing overhangs and dense back fins. Calibrate your flow rate properly and ensure your filament is completely dry—Bambu gray remains my absolute go-to filament for reading mechanical details flawlessly. Needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper make clearing support structures from the tight crevices of the mechanical wings incredibly efficient.

description: 🧚♂️ Magic Solar Fountain Fairy Sculpture ⛲ Bring a touch of fantasy and elegance to your garden with this functional Fairy Sculpture ! Designed from scratch, this beautiful piece doubles as a stunning garden ornament and a fully working water feature. It is designed specifically to fit the popular solar-powered water fountains from AliExpress ! 🌟 Key Features 📐 Perfect Fit: Features a precise Ø 10mm (fi 10mm) inner water channel/hole at the base, designed to slide directly onto the nozzle of the AliExpress solar pump shown in the photos. 🌹 Custom Spray Nozzle: The model comes with a dedicated water nozzle (included in the files) that you need to place inside the flower's opening to perfectly shape and direct the water stream. ⚙️ Tight Tolerance: The nozzle and the flower opening are engineered with a tight, press-fit tolerance to ensure a watertight seal without using glue. 💧 Internal Water Channel: The water flows seamlessly through the inside of the fairy and gracefully pours out of the flower, creating a mesmerizing and relaxing waterfall effect. 🌿 Garden & Outdoor Ready: Looks absolutely stunning in birdbaths, ponds, pots, or garden corners. 🖨️ Printing Recommendations ⚠️ IMPORTANT MATERIAL NOTE: You must print both the fairy and the dedicated nozzle using the exact same material (filament type and brand) . Because they are designed with a very tight press-fit tolerance, different materials shrink at different rates, which might cause the nozzle to be too loose or too tight! Material: PETG or ASA/ABS is highly recommended for long-term outdoor durability and water/UV resistance. Infill: 15-20% (Gyroid recommended for strength). Supports: Yes, tree supports are recommended for the wings and delicate features of the fairy. Wall Loops: Set to at least 3-4 walls to ensure the internal water channel and nozzle are completely watertight! 🛠️ How to Assemble Place your solar fountain disk in the water bowl/birdbath. Carefully insert the printed custom nozzle into the hole inside the fairy's flower (it's a tight fit, so press firmly). Push the fairy's bottom hole onto the 10mm water outlet pipe of the pump. Inspired by one of the world's most iconic street art motifs, this model is part of my Modern Art Collection —a series of 3D printable models inspired by famous works of art. After designing Balloon Girl and Floating Balloon Girl , I wanted to continue the collection with another iconic Banksy-inspired piece. Instead of creating a traditional multi-color print, I split the model into separate parts. The figure, bouquet wrapper and flowers are printed individually and assembled afterwards. This keeps print time and filament waste low while preserving the striking black, white and red color scheme (or any colors you choose). The flowers are intentionally simplified. My first version looked more realistic, but it proved difficult to print reliably. This stylized low-poly bouquet turned out to be a much better balance between appearance, printability and durability. Included Parts Figure Bouquet wrapper Flower bouquet Optional frame The frame is printed separately, so you can choose whether to display the model on its own or as framed wall art. I really enjoy turning iconic artworks into printable display pieces, and I hope this model fits nicely alongside my Balloon Girl and Floating Balloon Girl designs. Printing Notes No AMS required Figure requires supports Bouquet and wrapper print without supports The bouquet slides into the wrapper and can be glued if desired I hope you enjoy printing it! If you do, I'd love to see your make.

description: Roblox Animal Hospital: Skinwalker Anomaly Toy! 📋 Model Description Straight from the digital screens to your 3D printer, this model brings one of the most chilling modern gaming entities to life! Designed with a sleek, minimalist creature body, the figure's true horror is revealed in its massive, agape head. The gaping maw features rows of needle-sharp teeth surrounding a twisted, cavernous throat, perfectly capturing the terrifying jump-scare aesthetic. As a product designer, I engineered this model to ensure high structural integrity while optimizing it for exceptionally clean printing. The subtle, concentric-ring geometry of the wide, staring eyes contrasts beautifully with the sharp, aggressive angles of the teeth, making it a masterclass in modern character modeling and low-brow surrealism. 📜 Lore & Origin History If you've played the hit horror-survival experience Animal Hospital on Roblox , you know the absolute panic this entity brings. These shapeshifters and skinwalkers are the ultimate imposters. When they walk through the door or when you look at their check-in photos, they appear completely normal, innocent, and unassuming. But the rules of the hospital are clear: trust nothing but the tech . The anomaly only reveals its true form when standing directly at the reception window. By checking the waiting area CCTV camera feed, your screen is met with this exact nightmare—a horrific, wide-stretched mouth lined with razor-sharp fangs. This print is a physical manifestation of that exact terrifying realization! 💡 How It's Used & Functional Display This figure stands completely solid on its own two feet, making it an incredible desk companion, a standout shelf display piece for horror gaming fans, or a spooky guardian for your streaming setup. It serves as a fantastic conversational art piece for anyone who appreciates creepy-cute aesthetics, indie horror culture, or unique pop-art figures. 🔧 Remix Ideas & Creative Possibilities This entity is ripe for community remixes! Because all my files are posted for free, I love seeing what the community creates. Here are a few directions you can take this model: CCTV Desk Lamp: Hollow out the head and print the eyes or throat using a translucent filament, hiding a small LED inside to give it a ghostly, glowing aura. Macabre Desktop Organizer: Modify the massive open jaw to act as a functional desk dock that "bites" down on your phone charging cables, holds your business cards, or stores SD cards. Toothbrush Companion: Scale it up and place it in the bathroom as a hilarious, dark-humor toothbrush holder. The clever balance of the scene gives the sculpture a breathtaking sense of tension, motion, and magic, turning a timeless romantic metaphor into a physical reality. Place your printer on a stable, vibration-free surface, and confirm that vibration compensation is correctly calibrated. Before printing, double-check that your filament profile matches the material and that your bed temperature is properly set. For more tips on this topic, check out this video on YouTube. video (Youtube) . description: Ryuk ( Death Note ) Ryuk è uno Shinigami (un dio della morte) annoiato ed eccentrico, proveniente da una dimensione desolata e grigia. Per spezzare la monotonia del suo mondo, decide deliberatamente di far cadere il suo "Quaderno della Morte" ( Death Note ) sulla Terra, dando inizio agli eventi della serie. Aspetto Fisico: È una creatura imponente, alta e magra, dai tratti grotteschi e umanoidi. Ha una pelle pallida dalle sfumature grigio-azzurre, grandi occhi gialli e sporgenti con pupille rosse, e una bocca perennemente cucita in un sorriso inquietante e affilato. I suoi capelli sono neri, corti e sparati verso l'alto. Abbigliamento: Indossa un abito aderente di colore scuro, simile a pelle strappata o bende gotiche, arricchito da anelli, bracciali e una vistosa cintura decorata con teschi e catene metalliche. Sulla schiena porta enormi ali piumate nere, simili a quelle di un corvo, che può ritrarre a piacimento. Personalità e Vizi: Ryuk non è intrinsecamente malvagio, ma agisce puramente come un osservatore neutrale guidato dal proprio intrattenimento. Ha una profonda e totale dipendenza dalle mele del mondo umano , che per lui sono l'equivalente di una droga o dell'alcol (e la cui mancanza gli provoca vere e proprie crisi di astinenza). Descrizione delle Immagini (Modello 3D) Le immagini mostrano il modello tridimensionale di una statua da collezione ultra-dettagliata, concepita per la stampa 3D, catturata da quattro angolazioni differenti (frontale, posteriore, profilo sinistro e profilo destro) per mostrare la continuità e la coerenza della scultura senza alcuna modifica strutturale. 1. Visuale Frontale Ryuk è raffigurato in una posa accovacciata e dinamica. La gamba destra è piegata stretta al petto, mentre la gamba sinistra è distesa lateralmente verso l'esterno, creando un forte senso di asimmetria. Con la mano sinistra solleva una mela rossa lucida, portandola vicina al volto come se stesse per morderla, mentre il braccio destro è teso verso il basso, con le lunghe dita artigliate che sfiorano la base. Le ali sono spiegate lateralmente in tutta la loro ampiezza, incorniciando il personaggio. 2. Visuale Posteriore Dalla prospettiva posteriore emerge l'incredibile dettaglio anatomico e materico della scultura. L'attenzione è catturata dalla texture piumata delle grandi ali grigio-scuro, dove ogni singola piuma è scolpita individualmente. description: This is a 150 mm standing Catholic crucifix designed as a cleaner, easier print. The model separates the crucifix body from the base so the main cross section can be printed more efficiently with fewer major supports and less cleanup. The finished piece has a traditional devotional look with a sculpted corpus, INRI plaque, rectangular cross, and a stable display base. It works well as a home altar piece, prayer corner display, desk crucifix, shelf decoration, or Catholic gift. The two piece design makes the model easier to print than a single upright crucifix because the base and cross can be handled separately. After printing, the cross section fits into the base. A small amount of glue can be used if you want a permanent fit. Prints in a single material (PLA) — no multi-color or exotic filament needed. The included profile is tuned for the Bambu Lab X2D at 0.16mm for fine surface detail. Tree supports are pre-placed for the figure's overhangs and pop off cleanly thanks to a one-layer support gap. A stone, marble, or matte PLA gives a carved-statue look. Remove supports gently from the figure with flush cutters; a quick pass with a soft brush cleans up the interface marks. Print the stand in the same or a contrasting color. Optional: even easier support removal (AMS / multi-material If you have an AMS or a second filament, you can make the supports practically fall off. PETG doesn't bond to PLA, so using it only for the support interface gives a clean break with a smooth surface underneath: In Bambu Studio, open the Support tab. Set Interface filament to a slot loaded with PETG (keep the rest of the supports/body as PLA). Make sure there's a small support gap (the included profile already uses 0.16mm) and re-slice. Print as normal — the PLA body lifts right off the PETG interface. This is fully optional. The default single-PLA profile already releases cleanly; the PETG trick just makes cleanup even nicer if you have the filament on hand. If you make one, please share a photo and leave a like — it really helps!

description: Il Personaggio: Aang, l'Ultimo Dominatore dell'Aria Aang è il protagonista assoluto della serie animata Avatar - La leggenda di Aang . È un ragazzino apparentemente spensierato che porta sulle spalle il destino del mondo. Titoli Principali L'Avatar: L'unico individuo al mondo in grado di dominare tutti e quattro gli elementi (Aria, Acqua, Terra, Fuoco) e di fare da ponte tra il mondo degli umani e quello degli spiriti. L'Ultimo Dominatore dell'Aria: L'unico superstite del genocidio dei Nomadi dell'Aria perpetrato dalla Nazione del Fuoco. Legami con altri Personaggi Katara e Sokka: I fratelli della Tribù dell'Acqua del Sud che lo trovano intrappolato nell'iceberg. Katara diventa la sua insegnante di Dominio dell'Acqua (e in seguito il suo grande amore), mentre Sokka è la mente tattica (e comica) del gruppo. Toph Beifong: La formidabile e ironica dominatrice cieca che insegna ad Aang il Dominio della Terra, mostrandogli come essere saldo e diretto. Principe Zuko: Inizialmente il suo acerrimo inseguitore, ossessionato dal catturarlo per redimersi agli occhi del padre. Successivamente, Zuko compie una profonda evoluzione, diventando il suo mentore nel Dominio del Fuoco e un alleato fondamentale. Appa e Momo: Il suo fedele bisonte volante a sei zampe e il suo lemure alato, ultimi sprazzi della sua amata cultura d'origine. Descrizione Dettagliata del Modello Il modello da collezione rappresenta Aang in una posa dinamica e fortemente spirituale: Posa e Fisionomia: Aang è raffigurato in perfetto equilibrio su una gamba sola, una classica postura da monaco Shaolin che richiama la concentrazione e l'agilità dei Nomadi dell'Aria. Il volto mostra un'espressione serena ma focalizzata. I Tatuaggi Luminosi: Sulla fronte calva e sul dorso della mano spiccano i celebri tatuaggi a forma di freccia. Nel modello a colori sono resi con un effetto di retroilluminazione azzurro-bianca brillante, segno inequivocabile dell'attivazione dello Stato dell'Avatar . Abbigliamento e Colori: Indossa i tipici abiti dei Nomadi dell'Aria nelle tonalità dello zafferano, dell'arancione e del marrone bruciato. La mantellina corta copre le spalle, mentre una spessa fascia marrone stringe la vita, lasciando i pantaloni ampi per garantire libertà di movimento. Ai piedi porta stivali marroni alti. L'Arma: Dietro la schiena, tenuto saldamente con una mano, si trova il suo iconico bastone da aliante in legno marrone, impreziosito da intagli ornamentali dorati sulle giunzioni e sulle punte. La Base: Il personaggio poggia su una splendida piattaforma circolare finemente decorata. Sul piatto della base sono incisi i simboli dei quattro elementi, mentre il bordo esterno è circondato da una corona di fiamme stilizzate nei toni del rosso e dell'oro, che enfatizzano la natura epica della statuetta.

Hello Everyone! I created a few 3D printed convention badge ribbons for Convergence 2026. I figured with Dragoncon coming up, as well as other fan conventions with a badge ribbon trading culture, others may want to print these as well. They have a pleasing thickness but are not too thick or heavy. Perfect for pairing with other traditional ribbons. These match the standard 4" x 1 5/8" Badge Ribbons. These work best printed flat on the bed. The model comes with text “change me” included, simply change the font and text size as necessary. Do not adjust the embedded depth or thickness for best printing results. I find that rotating these 180 degrees to be face up while you're working on them is helpful, then re-flip when you're ready to print. You could add SVG graphics, just match the embedded depth and thickness to the text for best results. You should be able to fit 14 copies on a P1/P2/X1/X2/A1 bed, however makerworld is fussy about Prime Tower placement and the print profiles I've provided have 11 copies. The minimized prime tower settings in the profile should get you there, if you get a “g-code conflict” just move the prime tower around until it's happy. Print on a holographic bed for an even better effect! I recommend switching to a “smooth high temp plate” setting if you're going to do this and remember to run a bed level every time you switch plates. If using a 0.4mm nozzle, fonts with large spacing and bold details print better than fonts with minute details. Dry filament is important, any first/second layer issues will cause these to not look very good. Clean your plate with dish soap and water and dry thoroughly. Make sure to wash the plate if you accidentally touch it trying to get these off between batches. This should work with either PETG or PLA, but I find the most visually pleasing results with PLA, PETG can be too shiny. I recommend using “Scor-Tape” ½" Double Sided Adhesive Tape to for the tape to attach to badges and other ribbons, which can be found at this link: https://amzn.to/3RmYxYj (affiliate link)

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. description: 《软绒星瞳》是一枚以“治愈系萌宠”为灵感的雕塑戒指，它将猫咪的软萌与戒指的佩戴性完美结合，打造出一款兼具艺术感与治愈感的独特饰品。戒指同样采用奶白色哑光材质打造，质感温润细腻，自带柔和的柔光效果，仿佛被赋予了温度，上手后自带温柔的氛围感。 戒指的核心设计，是一只从戒环中探出脑袋的软萌猫咪。猫咪的造型采用了全立体雕刻，从毛茸茸的脸颊、尖俏的耳朵，到圆溜溜的眼睛、粉嫩的小鼻子，再到探出戒环的两只小肉垫，每一处细节都刻画得栩栩如生。猫咪的毛发纹理细腻逼真，层层叠叠的绒毛雕刻，让它看起来软乎乎的，仿佛伸手就能摸到它蓬松的毛；圆溜溜的眼睛温润透亮，没有多余的装饰，却自带无辜又灵动的眼神，像藏着星光一样，自带治愈感；两只肉垫搭在戒环上，肉垫的弧度与纹理都被精心还原，仿佛猫咪正乖乖趴在你的指尖撒娇，可爱感拉满。戒环的内侧同样打磨光滑，佩戴时贴合指腹，圆润的边缘不会硌手，兼顾了可爱造型与佩戴的舒适感。 这枚戒指的设计，藏着关于陪伴与治愈的温柔寓意。猫咪象征着陪伴与治愈，而这枚戒指就像一只永远趴在你指尖的小猫咪，无论何时何地，都能给你带来温柔的慰藉。它打破了传统饰品的刻板印象，将萌宠元素与雕塑艺术结合，打造出独一无二的风格，无论是日常通勤搭配休闲装，还是搭配甜酷风、温柔风的穿搭，都能轻松适配，让你的指尖自带一份软萌又高级的氛围感。 English: "Starry-Eyed Kitten" is a sculptural ring inspired by the "healing charm of pets". Summary A lightweight, ultra‑compact and efficient system designed to lock your shoelaces without tying a knot . description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Hey guys! :) Are you looking for a cool print to level up your Victorian/Steampunk costumes? Do you wish to bring a little bit of your “Maker” personality to your RP character for DnDs, renfaires, and festivals? Well, then this one is especially for you! :D This model is very close to my heart. :)) Not only did I LOVE creating it and fusing every aesthetic I enjoy into one model, but now I can cosplay as like.. myself? But like a cooler version of myself in a fantasy setting? YES. 💅🏼✨ 📌What do you need to know? (Before printing) This is a multipart design, with two separate frame looks that you can choose between. One of the frames has a clean/industrial steampunk look, and the other has a more ornate Victorian look with foliage patterns. Both frames are included in the design profile on separate plates. I designed the assembly first for compatibility with laser-cut 3 mm PMMA (acrylic) lenses, but then I decided to make it more accessible to everyone by including an FDM-printable version of the lenses. So you can print this full design even without laser cutting. Just keep in mind that the FDM version is mostly a prop for wearing overhead, since I personally couldn't see anything behind the printed lenses. :D Also, these goggles are gigantic by design. :D Please don't scale them up or down, by doing that the assembly won't be possible anymore. 📌What about additional components? I put the DXF file for the laser-cut acrylic lenses in this model if you'd like to cut your own see-through lenses. You can find them under the “Download STL/CAD files” section. For the forehead lights, I used mini battery-powered LEDs of 10x15 mm (Dxh). You can see an example here . Although I didn't include them yet in my versions, the movable mechanical assembly on the side is there to integrate a magnifying lens with a diameter of 20 mm into your glasses if you want. You can see an example here . 📌Print notes: Since this design has several print plates and objects with various settings, I suggest you open the 3MF directly in Bambu Studio and check out the requirements for each group of objects. 📌Post-printing and assembly: This design requires only minimal support, and most of the clean-up is for the brims (since there are quite a few small and separate components). However, there is a small “bridge” that you'll need to clean up before the assembly. Push it open with a hot or sharp tool to have access to the back of your LED and printed insert, so you can push them out from behind if needed. After cleaning, assembling the goggles is quite straightforward. You won't need any glue or additional joining components. Here are some additional guides. I really like that you enjoy this design as much as I did, and happy printing! :) 🥂✨

I've been really wanting to try out iron-on t-shirt printing since the first time I saw it on Bambu. I decided on this fun design that I saw on Temu a while back. This was printed onto parchment paper that was secured to the plate with magnets and tape (on the back side), with Elmer's glue for additional adhesion (it washes off after). Please read the recommendations and instructions below carefully - they are crucial for a great print. It was a few iterations to find the right way to print this, so here are my recommendations: Only Ever Use TPU Filament: Do not attempt this with PLA or PETG. TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) is a flexible rubber that acts exactly like a hot-melt adhesive when ironed, allowing it to permanently fuse into the fabric fibers. Rigid plastics will not bond correctly and will shatter or peel right off the shirt Go with Exactly 1 Layer: Scale your model's Z-height to 0.3mm and match your initial layer height to it. ( prevents the nozzle from dragging and it won't be heavy on the T-shirt ) Crawl the Speeds: Parchment paper has zero traction. You must restrict all slicer speed settings to force a slow, consistent crawl. Cap your Initial Layer Infill , Gap Infill , Outer/Inner Walls , and Top Surface all down to 20–30 mm/s . Dial in Retractions & Z-Hop: Enable a Normal Z-Hop (0.4mm) so the toolhead lifts straight up like an elevator between letters instead of dragging strings. Increase your retraction length to 1.2mm–1.5mm to stop TPU ooze. Use a Washable Glue Stick: Apply a thin, even layer of standard Elmer’s washable glue stick to the parchment paper before printing. It provides just enough tackiness to anchor fine details (like text and icons). Any leftover residue on the fabric completely dissolves on the shirt's very first wash cycle! Bed Temp: Drop the bed to 45°C and secure the paper tightly with strong magnets around the perimeter to keep it perfectly flat. Ironing: Place the print design-side-down on the shirt, press firmly with a dry iron (Medium/Wool setting) for 15 seconds without sliding it around, and let it cool completely before peeling! Enjoy printing this, and make sure to post your makes below—I'd love to see what designs you create! Happy printing!

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 🛍️ Trash Bag – L'eleganza nasce dove nessuno se l'aspetta Chi ha detto che il lusso debba seguire sempre le stesse regole? Trash Bag nasce proprio da questa provocazione: prendere qualcosa di estremamente semplice e quotidiano e trasformarlo in un accessorio capace di attirare ogni sguardo. È una borsa che gioca con i contrasti, mescolando ironia, design contemporaneo e raffinatezza in un oggetto unico. Le sue superfici sfaccettate ricordano un tessuto morbido che si è cristallizzato nel tempo, creando una geometria elegante e dinamica che cambia aspetto a seconda della luce. Il grande fiocco che funge da manico non è solo un dettaglio decorativo, ma il simbolo della sua personalità: romantica, femminile e audace allo stesso tempo. L'ispirazione arriva dalle linee sinuose del Liberty e dell' Art Nouveau , reinterpretate in chiave moderna attraverso la stampa 3D. Il risultato è una borsa dal carattere deciso, capace di sembrare una piccola opera d'arte più che un semplice accessorio. Che venga stampata in colori pastello delicati, in finiture opache, seta o perlati, Trash Bag cambia completamente personalità, diventando ogni volta un pezzo esclusivo. È perfetta per chi ama il design, la moda alternativa e gli oggetti che raccontano una storia. ✨ Design originale e fuori dagli schemi 🎀 Grande manico a forma di fiocco, elegante e scenografico ✨ Superficie geometrica ispirata agli origami e ai drappeggi della stoffa 💎 Perfetta come accessorio fashion, pezzo da collezione o elemento d'arredo moderno 🖨️ Progettata per valorizzare al massimo la stampa 3D con dettagli puliti e una finitura impeccabile Divertiti a personalizzarla con i tuoi filamenti preferiti: ogni colore le regalerà un'anima diversa. Dal rosa cipria al nero satinato, dal bianco perlato ai colori più vivaci... ogni Trash Bag sarà davvero unica. 📸 Hai stampato la tua versione? Pubblicala su MakerWorld ! Sono curioso di vedere le vostre combinazioni di colori, finiture e interpretazioni personali. 📖 La storia di Trash Bag La leggenda racconta che il primo prototipo nacque quasi per gioco. Un designer osservava un semplice sacchetto appoggiato sul tavolo del suo studio. Era stropicciato, imperfetto, destinato a essere buttato. Eppure, tra quelle pieghe casuali, vide qualcosa che nessun altro aveva notato: eleganza. Da quell'idea nacque una sfida. E se ciò che normalmente viene considerato banale potesse diventare qualcosa di prezioso? Così, piega dopo piega, curva dopo curva, quel concetto prese forma fino a trasformarsi in una borsa dal carattere inconfondibile. Il grande fiocco rappresenta il gesto finale: il momento in cui l'ordinario si veste di straordinario. Per questo Trash Bag non è solo una borsa. È un piccolo manifesto di creatività, un invito a guardare il mondo con occhi diversi e a trovare bellezza dove gli altri vedono soltanto normalità.
Design minimalista mais delicado e com muita graça. Você vai vender muito.

This is a fully 3D-printable eyewear design that you can print, finish, and assemble entirely at home. It requires no screws, hinges, or extra hardware—all you need is some super glue and a bit of post-processing to get a clean, functional pair of glasses. This model is designed to support standard and prescription lenses, making it both a stylish accessory and a practical daily wear option. Key Features Two Sizes Included: Comes in two different sizes to help ensure a proper fit for different face shapes. Lens-Ready: Designed to accommodate both standard non-prescription lenses and prescription lenses. 100% Hardware-Free: No need to source tiny screws or specialized hinges. Easy Assembly: Simple joint design secured with a small amount of super glue. Recommended Print Settings To ensure the best surface finish and structural strength, the following settings are recommended: Layer Height: 0.10mm to 0.15mm (highly recommended for smoother curves and easier sanding) Infill: 40% – 50% Supports: Required. You will need to enable supports for the curved sections of the temples (the arms that go behind the ears). Material Compatibility This model has been tested with several filaments, and you can print it using almost any standard material: Bambu PLA-CF: Highly recommended. The carbon fiber texture provides a premium matte finish and excellent structural rigidity. Wood PLA: Gives a unique, organic aesthetic. It looks great but will require extra sanding and finishing to get a smooth feel. Standard PLA/PETG: Works well and offers a wide range of color choices. Assembly & Post-Processing Sanding: To achieve a comfortable fit and clean look, thoroughly sand the frames and temples. Start with a coarser grit (like 220) to smooth out print lines, and finish with a wet sand (400 to 1000 grit) for a smooth surface. Dry Fit: Test-fit the temples into the frame joints before applying any glue to ensure they align properly. Gluing: Apply a very small drop of super glue (cyanoacrylate) to the connection points. Hold the pieces firmly in place Lens Installation How to install: Standard scanned or custom-cut lenses can be snapped directly into the frame from the inside. Important Note: Do not apply heat (such as hot water or a hairdryer) to the frame during installation. Heating the plastic can cause the printed frame to warp or lose its shape. The lenses are designed to snap into place easily at room temperature.

Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Slicer Instructions To achieve the intended flexibility and mechanical action, please use these specific settings: Spiral Vase Mode: Enabled Wall Thickness: Exactly 0.4mm Brim: Disabled (None) Crucial Printing Tips Because these models utilize a single wall with no brim, first-layer adhesion is critical to prevent the fins from warping or releasing from the bed mid-print. description: I bring to you a glasses/sunglasses case that features a magnetic latch mechanism, allowing one-hand operation. It uses 3 12x3mm magnets to enable a tight locking/unlocking mechanism depending on the position of the latch. Make sure to insert the magnets using the right polarity, such that one of them will attract the magnet in the latch—securing the case in the closed position—, while the other will repel it—pushing it away and, hence, opening the case. In the print profile you will find two plates with one version each: “Independent_parts”. This plate prints the bottom and top parts independently, so you can print them in different colors. You will have to put them together to enable the hinge mechanism. Be aware that it might require some strength to insert the hinge in place. “Print_in_place”. This second plate features a print-in-place version. You won't have to put the top and bottom parts together, since they will be already printed together, with the hinge in place after printing. It might require a slight "breaking" by turning the hinge, just in case that the clearance is to tight for your printer resolution, but the parts should be apart enough to avoid melting and still providing the hinge natural rotating motion. There is a lot of room for improvement/enhancing, and I will continue working on this model to provide more sizes, as well as softer inserts to keep the glasses even more secure inside the case. Happy printing/protecting/transporting!

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Gedruckt wurde das Modell auf einem Bambu Lab H2C mit AMS. Der Schlüsselanhänger kann sowohl mit einer 0,2 mm als auch mit einer 0,4 mm Düse gedruckt werden. Für feinere Details bei Namen und kleinen Schriften empfehle ich aber klar die 0,2 mm Düse. Auf Druckplatte 1 befindet sich ein komplettes Blanko-Exemplar ohne Personalisierung. Druckplatte 2 enthält die personalisierbare Version mit Name und Rückennummer. Über den Textgenerator könnt ihr euren eigenen Namen, Nummern und auch andere Schriftarten verwenden. Druckplatte 3 und 4 sind im Prinzip identisch zu 1 und 2, allerdings ist das Modell hier halbiert. Dadurch liegen beide Außenseiten direkt auf der Druckplatte und bekommen die strukturierte PEI-Oberfläche. Außerdem wirken die Farbübergänge dadurch sauberer und weniger sichtbar. Die halbierten Versionen sind so konstruiert, dass sie bei einem Druck mit 0,4 mm Düse meistens einfach zusammengesteckt bzw. eingeklipst werden können. Bei einem Druck mit 0,2 mm Düse kann es je nach Drucktoleranz sein, dass etwas Kleber benötigt wird. Ich selbst verwende einen PLA-Kleber, der die Teile innerhalb von ungefähr einer Minute nahezu untrennbar miteinander verbindet. description: A functional, aesthetic charging and display stand based around the Pebble Time 2! Includes an indent for the heart rate sensor and a non-slip TPU 95A foot. HARDWARE This project requires a couple things: Your Pebble magnetic charger. If you don't want to use the one that came with your watch, I have had luck with this one from Amazon . There are a few like this, but if you buy one without the USB C port make sure it has a thin (preferably flat), flexible cable. Right-angle USB-C adapter. If you don't use a charger with an attached cable, you will need one of these. Make sure it is slim. The fitment was modeled after one similar to these from Ugreen . USB-C cable, if you aren't using a charger with one attached. Just use one of the hundreds you have laying around at this point! 4x M3x25mm self-tapping screws. Mine came from this set . These are optional, but I like the look of screws instead of using glue and it's easier to take apart. PRINTING TIPS I have carefully painted supports, infill & walls on the included print profiles. There should be no need to tweak them. Ironing is enabled on the Pebble logo to look nice and smooth. This can be tweaked or disabled to your preference. If printing from the step files, note the following: The stand is best printed on its side so that the curves are smooth and the inset on the bottom is accurate. Ensure that your bridging is calibrated and well-tuned Ensure that the widest part of the stand at least is supported; tree supports can angle into the cavity about 10mm while remaining on the build plate and I found that to be sufficient Ensure that the inset at the bottom of the stand for the foot is supported; I had to paint on supports manually since the slicer kept wanting to print that as an overhang. The inlay side (pebble logo) of the watch holder should be printed face down and should not need supports - they're hard to remove. However, the cantilever for the heart rate sensor does need support. Print the stand and foot at 100% infill (or 1000 walls, your preference). This is to ensure they are weighty enough to offset the high weight when the watch is on the stand. Print the foot on a textured PEI plate if using TPU. I recommend 95A TPU or SEBS. The texture on the plate, when applied to the foot, greatly enhances grip. Assembly Print and Gather your parts Insert the charger (with right angle connector if applicable) into the cavity. There is an indent for the lanyard if you do not want to remove it. The lanyard can also be used to add some friction by sliding it underneath the magnetic charger. Plug the cord in and feed it through the cavity in the stand. Slide the stand onto the watch holder. Fitment is tight, so a small amount of force may be necessary. It may be easiest to slide the watch holder onto the stand, feeding the charger into the cavity as you do so. Secure 4x M3x25mm self-tapping screws into the four holes on the side of the stand. Screw them all the way in so their heads are flush to ensure that they have secured the holder to the stand. Click the logo inlay into place. It should not require glue, but a little dab does not hurt. Insert the foot into the inset in the bottom. The small peg should align to the small hole next to the cord cutout. Do not glue this in or the cord will be impossible to remove later. Fill your coffee!

description: Say Goodbye to the Claw-Clip Head Bump! My wife was looking for a viral magnetic hair clip that solved this problem, but it was sold out everywhere. So, I decided to design my own! This Flat Magnetic Hair Clip is a modular, low-profile system. Instead of one bulky claw, this design uses two separate pieces held in each hand. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs.
